status: Frozen descriptive full-audit protocol; historical results are not relabeled
input: Each frame's own native stored 256x256 pred_masks logits, thresholded at the native zero logit
primary_operator: Call unchanged Efficient-SAM2 select_mask_windows on foreground and its complement, one memory token per window. Both occupied means mixed/boundary-associated; foreground only means interior; background only means background.
attribution: Primary is a project three-class composition of unchanged Efficient-SAM2 occupancy, conceptually a mixed-window rule. It is NOT Mask Transfiner's incoherence rule and is not claimed as an unchanged BPR implementation. Mask Transfiner is a separate author-function comparator.
primary_limits: Mixed footprints, not semantically pure vectors or all geometric contours. Perfectly grid-aligned contours may produce no mixed cells. Image borders are not automatically boundaries.

transfiner.categorical_adapter: Author-saturated scores equal to one become boundary-associated. Retain raw scores. Bilinear sampling and the author's 0.01 cutoff are unchanged; thin structures can be missed.

matteformer.adaptations: Fix author RNG width responses, disable random interpolation, provide local np.int compatibility; discard segmentation augmentation. Nearest-neighbor map from native256 to memory64. Not an unchanged end-to-end matting pipeline.

comparators.v3: Retain Boundary IoU inner-band geometry at ratio 0.02 on direct native object tokens. Measure disagreement with the older full-resolution-PNG re-encoding route.

pilot: Complete seq2 and seq3, CPU FP32, fresh-model no-observer replay, same checkpoint and one initial GT mask
checks: Prediction returned by propagation equals the same frame's stored output
Saved PNG binary equals the same stored frame's upsampled mask
Prompt native low-resolution logits equal SAM2's unchanged mask-prompt path
Actual memory-encoder write identified by stored feature hash; writer mask signs agree with native logits upsampled by author interpolation
Square 1024x1024 overlays with 16-pixel memory grid and GT contour
Native logits unchanged relative to fresh-model no-observer replay
Attention mass sums to one per read, all four memory cross-attention layers

contour_measurement.source: Unchanged Boundary IoU mask_to_boundary at native256, ratio 1/hypot(256,256), giving one-pixel inner contour including image border
contour_measurement.coverage: Count contour pixels outside nearest-neighbor enlarged 64x64 boundary-token footprints; record numerator and denominator on every audited frame for every definition
contour_measurement.references: Self contour from own native prediction isolates assignment geometry. GT contour from SAM2 prompt-path resized GT is separate: misses include prediction errors. GT is never substituted for predicted memory.
contour_measurement.image_border: Accept the author border convention for the inner-band comparator, explicitly not anatomical; also report contour coverage excluding the outermost native raster row/column and image-edge-contact frequency
contour_measurement.undefined: Zero contour denominator gives null, not zero. Empty regional groups give undefined enrichment, not zero. Frame/region counts are reported.

size_strata: Freeze positive GT area-fraction quartiles from all seq1–23 source frames before model inference. Ties enter the lower quartile; absent separate. Report cutpoints and all bin counts; no outcome-driven bin choice.
claim_rule: Claims concern positions associated with regions, never exclusive semantic contents of vectors. Attention allocation alone is not causal contribution. A definition-robust regional effect requires consistent direction across primary mixed cells, author incoherence, all prespecified trimaps and inner band; otherwise report definition dependence without selecting a winning width. Segmentation contribution requires CPU FP32 exclusion with contiguity-matched controls; no gain is presumed.
full_rerun: Run all 23 sequences after a matching-source CPU seq2/seq3 exact-replay and delivery gate. Audit every source frame: promptable frames have native memory measurements; preprompt and unpromptable frames have explicitly GT-reference-only assignment statistics, never fabricated memory/attention. Full-cohort prediction replay is not implied by the two-sequence gate.
causal_exclusion: CPU FP32 contiguity-matched exclusions remain subsequent work; count-only controls do not establish the requested stronger control.
